notes.title: Update 1.0.0 Release
notes.content:
[h1]lone.AI 1.0.0 Update[/h1]
With this update, lone.AI is now available! Thank you to everyone who helped test and provide feedback. Moving forward, lone.AI will continue to receive updates and fixes based on community input. This update introduces run missions, visual enhancements, and more. Below is a full list of changes.

[h2][b]NEW[/b] Run Missions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Each run features a mission for rewards that can be rerolled.
[*]Unlock: [spoiler]Win one time.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] A reroll stat has been added to the information tab at the AI Station.
[*][b]NEW[/b] The casino game can now be rerolled once per run.
[*]The delay for fast sell has been decreased.
[*]Some menus have been enhanced.
[*]Fixed Necula's shot cooldown allowing multiple upgrades at once.
[/list]
[h2]Modules[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Reveal Module: [spoiler]Reveals all skills in the skill tree.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Glitch Module: [spoiler]Periodically does something random.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Glycerol Module: [spoiler]Applies toxic damage to a nearby enemy.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Whysoad Module: [spoiler]Fires a sound wave at random.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Music Module: [spoiler]Periodically fires music notes.[/spoiler]
[*]Including all modules this brings the total number to 59.
[*]Fixed module chest not spawning when two are bought simultaneously.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Steam achievements have now been implemented, with a total of 34 achievements.
[*]Changed the gameplay background.
[*]Made some HUD displays look more appealing.
[*]Boss music has been added.
[*]Adjusted number rounding on some stats.
[*]The EULA has been removed.
[*]Other minor bug fixes and changes.
[/list]

[h3][i]Digital Drank[/i][/h3]

notes.title: lone.AI Loot Update
notes.content:
[h1]lone.AI Beta 0.9.0 Update[/h1]
This update introduces an improved looting system. Combined with the previous rerolls update and other additions, it becomes much easier to create your build. Below is a complete list of the changes.

[h2][b]NEW[/b] Object Info[/h2]
[list]
[*]All loot and objects now display more detailed info when targeted or hovered over.
[*]Modules now show their name, description, some stats, and rerolls.
[*]Pickups now show their name, description, and some stats.
[*]Enemies now display their names and more when using specific modules.
[/list]
[h2]Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added three new abilities that you can choose from at the beginning of a new run.
[*][b]NEW[/b] Melee Ability: [spoiler]Deal a powerful frontal attack.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Module Ability: [spoiler]Chance to spawn a module chest; using it increases the chances.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Repair Ability: [spoiler]Repairs a small portion of the hull.[/spoiler]
[*]Changed how mines deal damage.
[/list]
[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Secret: [spoiler]An unmapped planet is now functional.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Secret: [spoiler]A rare station can spawn and be available for use.[/spoiler]
[*]Beacon objectives now have a navigation arrow when within range.
[*]More dialog options and responses unlock as you progress.
[/list]
[h2]Modules[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Scanner Module: [spoiler]The targeted enemy displays its current hull.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Attack Damage Module: [spoiler]Increases attack damage, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Plasma Damage Module: [spoiler]Increases plasma damage, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Shot Spawner Module: [spoiler]Periodically drops a basic shot.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Plasma Spawner Module: [spoiler]Periodically drops a plasma shot.[/spoiler]
[*]Including all modules this brings the total number to 54.
[*]Changed spread shot module to random spread up to 360 degrees.
[*]Changed extra shots module to add one fewer bullet per shot.
[/list]
[h2]Skill Tree[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Added five new skills as roll options in the skill tree.
[*]Added Fire Back, Spinning Laser, Plasma Orbit, AI Dialog Shot, and Module skills.
[*]Fixed plasma orbiting shot from disappearing after using a portal.
[*]You can no longer purchase the repair skill if your hull is already full.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Overhauled much of the HUD information for better clarity and usability.
[*]Added an aimer when using the controller twin setting.
[*]Fixed various bugs that occurred when using a controller.
[*]Added notification for when a remote access not unlocked is used.
[*]Other minor bug fixes and changes.
[/list]

[h3][i]Digital Drank[/i][/h3]

notes.title: lone.AI Enters Beta!
notes.content:
[h1]lone.AI Beta 0.1.0 Update[/h1]
Once again, thank you to everyone testing lone.AI. We're entering the beta phase, with most main features complete. While some new features will still be added, the focus will now shift to bug fixes, polishing, and optimization as I prepare for release. Below is a list of additions and changes in lone.AI Beta Build 0.1.0.

[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*]The planet Iter is now fully functional.
[*]Iter: [spoiler]Has the usual inquire and missions. Added Bullet Trade.[/spoiler] 
[*]The planet Zeranda is now fully functional.
[*]Zeranda: [spoiler]Has the usual inquire and missions. Added Modules Shop.[/spoiler] 
[*]The planet Necula is now fully functional.
[*]Necula: [spoiler]Has the usual inquire and missions. Added Damage Enhancer.[/spoiler] 
[*]This brings the total number of functional locations to 13.
[*][b]NEW[/b] Bullet Trade: [spoiler]Trade crystals and swap the damage of your basic shots or plasma shots.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Modules Shop: [spoiler]Purchase a module chest and explore various other modules to acquire.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Damage Enhancer: [spoiler]Purchase various damage upgrades for this run and permanently.[/spoiler]
[*]3 Unlockable stickers added to the AI Station.
[/list]
[h2][b]NEW[/b] AI Dialog Box[/h2]
[list]
[*]AI Dialog: The AI will now provide helpful information throughout a run.
[*]AI Box: [spoiler]Modules and upgrades are available to enhance the AI's dialog box capabilities.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h2]Modules[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] AI Shot Module: [spoiler]The AI's dialog box will fire at enemies.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] AI Nova Module: [spoiler]The AI's dialog box will generate a nova from incoming messages.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] FroggPrincess Module: [spoiler]Send space frogs after your enemies.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Fire Back Module: [spoiler]Your crosshair will fire back, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Crosshair Target Module: [spoiler]Clicking can cause damage at the crosshairs location.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Stats Module: [spoiler]Gives two additional stat points, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Skills Module: [spoiler]Gives one additional skill point, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*]Including all modules this brings the total number to 38.
[/list]
[h2]Asteroids[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] A rare anomaly may now enhance all asteroids during a run.
[*]Green: [spoiler]Asteroids give technology instead of metal ore.[/spoiler]
[*]Silver: [spoiler]Asteroids give metal scrap instead of metal ore.[/spoiler]
[*]Gold: [spoiler]Asteroids give more credits instead of metal ore with a chance to spawn a module chest.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted button effects and animations.
[*]Certain objects will now be deleted instead of hidden.
[*]Disabled smoothing on some objects.
[*]Made other minor adjustments to enhance performance.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]

[*]Other minor bug fixes and changes.

[*][spoiler]Introducing five super modules, which are rarer and more powerful than regular modules.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Hull Super Module: [spoiler]Increases max hull by 200+, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Shield Super Module: [spoiler]Increases max shield by 100+, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Stats Super Module: [spoiler]Increases multiple stats, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Multi Shot Super Module: [spoiler]Add ten bullets per shot, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Rapid Fire Super Module: [spoiler]Shot cooldown set to minimum.[/spoiler]
[*]Including all modules this brings the total number to 31.
[/list]
[h2]Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed hull regeneration skill in skill tree to restore the correct amount.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pressing the escape key now goes back or exits location.
[*]Other minor bug fixes and changes.
[/list]

[h3][i]Digital Drank[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.0.8 For Alpha Testers
notes.content:
[h1]lone.AI Alpha 0.0.8 Update[/h1]
Thank you to everyone testing lone.AI. I've received your feedback and taken all of it into consideration. The majority of comments were about the game's difficulty being too high. I've made adjustments to the difficulty settings, along with several other updates. Below is a list of additions and changes in lone.AI Alpha Build 0.0.8.

[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Crouka Slime is now fully functional.
[*]Crouka Slime: [spoiler]Purchase an upgrade for your chosen ability.[/spoiler] 
[*]Midway Casino is now fully functional.
[*]Midway Casino: [spoiler]Each run the casino can have a different game to win credits or prizes.[/spoiler] 
[*]Portals are now available to teleport to at the beginning of each run once unlocked.
[*]Portals Unlock: [spoiler]AI Station, Gavis, and Thonia remote access unlocked.[/spoiler]
[*]Portals: [spoiler]Each portal has permanent stat upgrades available.[/spoiler]
[*]This brings the total number of functional locations to eight:
Crouka Slime, Midway Casino, Gavis, Thonia, the AI Station, and the Portals.
[/list]
[h2][b]NEW[/b] Traveling Merchant[/h2]
[list]
[*][spoiler]The traveling merchant may be found visiting many locations.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The traveling merchant deals in food, luxury goods, and offers a module chest for sale.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h2]Modules[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Laser Module: [spoiler]Periodically creates a spinning laser.[/spoiler] 
[*][b]NEW[/b] Extra Shots Module: [spoiler]Adds extra bullets per shot, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler] 
[*][b]NEW[/b] Spread Shot Module: [spoiler]Shot spread is random.[/spoiler] 
[*][b]NEW[/b] Auto Fire Module: [spoiler]Automatically fires your shots.[/spoiler] 
[*][b]NEW[/b] Slime Module: [spoiler]Unlocks Crouka Slime remote access.[/spoiler] 
[*][b]NEW[/b] Casino Module: [spoiler]Unlocks Midway Casino remote access.[/spoiler] 
[*]This brings the total number of modules to 22.
[*]Added a highlight around dropped modules.
[*]Added an animation on module icons when first acquired.
[*]Slightly increased module chest spawn chance.
[/list]
[h2]Decreased Difficulty[/h2]
[list]
[*]Decreased the amount of initial enemies that will spawn.
[*]Decreased the damage of enemies basic attack.
[*]Added Survivor Bonus: [spoiler]Gain credits for every minute survived.[/spoiler] 
[*]Decreased vortex speed.
[*]Increased wrench pickup repair amount.
[*]Increased credits pickup amount.
[*]Increased rewards for destroying enemies.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]The game now stays paused when exiting a menu or location.
[*]Other minor bug fixes and changes.
[/list]

[h3][i]Digital Drank[/i][/h3]
